single.rationale: The IPG merger completed in late November 2025 creates significant near-term integration complexity and uncertainty. While FY2025 revenue grew 10.1% to $17.3B and FCF was strong at $2.8B (16.1% margin), operating income collapsed to $445M (2.6% margin) and net income turned negative at -$54.5M, reflecting one month of IPG results and integration costs. The dramatically increased debt load ($9.3B vs $6.1B) and the non-comparability of financials make near-term performance highly uncertain despite attractive FCF yield.
